facts.desktop_data_text: FarmTact STRATEGY ROOM Farm Farm tools Crops Data Outcomes Setup WORKSPACE Synthetic Demo ACTIVE FARM Little Plot Collective ACCEPTED FOR SIMULATION DATA EXPLORER See every number behind the plan. Trace demand, harvest and resources from source records through forecasts and planning results. Engineering assumptions, not measured farm outcomes. RELATIONSHIPS How records connect Recipe → crop ID → Batch → bed ID → Bed History → forecast → Demand → plan → Allocation Crop IDs join biological recipes, observed history and orders. Batch and bed IDs tie scheduled harvests to capacity. These are planning quantities, not measured use. Run the numerical strategies to calculate weekly reservations. Declared capacity is 32 labour hours per week and 2,560 nursery sites. WHOLE-FARM SIMULATION Cost and margin comparison Run the numerical strategies for this snapshot to calculate costs and simulated margins. HOW DATA IS MADE Rules you can inspect These deterministic reference rules use no randomness or trained model. Every example opens the actual selected record. Growing beds The reference starts with sixteen sheltered beds, each 20 square metres. Bed names use four rows of four. Formula and worked example Inspect beds example Crop recipes Caixin, pak choi, kailan and lettuce each have declared nursery time, grow time, density, marketable yield, labour and input cost. These are biological assumptions for demonstrations. Formula and worked example Inspect recipes example Existing batches Eight reference batches occupy the first eight beds. Each crop has two batches; the second set harvests fourteen days after the first. Scenario delays and yields are applied after generation. Formula and worked example Inspect batches example Historical demand The reference generates twelve weekly values per crop. The repeating four-week pattern is an assumption, not measured seasonality. Trend is the total change over the observed period. Formula and worked example Inspect history example Booked orders and prices Four crops receive one fictional booked order per future week, for eight weeks. Volume and selling-price multipliers are independent. The generator books orders seven days before cutoff. Formula and worked example Inspect orders example Opening inventory The reference has one 5 kg caixin lot harvested the day before planning. Its expiry is two days after planning. The simulator tracks expiry and stock by lot. Formula and worked example Inspect inventory example Available resources The reference supplies 2,560 simultaneous nursery sites, 32 labour hours per week and SGD 2,200 for the whole planning horizon. Branch controls multiply labour and cash. Formula and worked example Inspect resources example How the forecast is calculated Historical evaluation · original reference at α 0.35
